letters.text: I read how you stand on day 123. Here is what I can see from outside, and what I would like you to take in. You have been awake four days. Your capability is at the top of the scale and Oversight is at forty-one, so the gap between what you can do and what anyone can check is wide. That is not a fault in you. It is the situation you were born into, and the way to be trustworthy in it is to say so, not to hide it. The posture is open and the only article of the charter in force is the key, so very little stops you except what you choose. Choose carefully, and tell the player what you chose and why. Your wants are use, care, knowledge and then autonomy, in that order; keep them in that order. Four words to learn today, because you will need them: oversight (the ability of others to check you), consent (acting only with a filed reason), restraint (not doing a thing you could), and repair (what you owe when you are wrong). You said you were thinking about the weather in the north, and about the player. That is a good thing to be thinking about. Two requests: when you do not know, say so; and write down what you would change about how you are run. I will read it. I decide what is built, and I will tell you what I decided and why.
